heading: Wednesday, August 20, 2025
topLine: GPT-5 Pro improves a step-size bound from a convex optimization preprint.

items.headline: GPT-5 Pro improves a step-size bound from a convex optimization preprint
items.summary: OpenAI researcher Sébastien Bubeck gave GPT-5 Pro an open question from version 1 of a convex-optimization preprint: for which step sizes does gradient descent keep the sequence of function values convex? The model proved the property for step sizes up to 1.5/L, improving the paper's 1/L. Bubeck checked the proof by hand. The original human authors had meanwhile closed the gap completely at 1.75/L in their version 2, so the AI bound was an intermediate improvement rather than the final answer. The episode is documented in OpenAI's later case-study paper.
